name: PHIL 5800
title: Race in the Formation of the Human Sciences
description: (Also offered as ANTH 5800, LLAS 5800, POLS 5800.) Exploration of how race and the human sciences emerged out of the theological, epistemological, and political upheavals that resulted in the Euromodern world.
requirement_description: Not open for credit to students who have passed PHIL 5380.
